LanceGetPasswordText:
LANCE: It takes
two passwords to

get into the
boss's quarters.

Those passwords
are known only to a few ROCKETS.

That ROCKET there
very graciously told me so.

, let's go
get the passwords.
TeamRocketBaseB3FRocketText:
Urrggh… The guy
in the cape is incredibly tough…
RocketBaseRivalText:
…

Didn't I tell you
that I was going

to destroy TEAM
ROCKET?

…Tell me, who was
the guy in the

cape who used
dragon #MON?

My #MON were no
match at all.

I don't care that
I lost. I can beat

him by getting
stronger #MON.

It's what he said
that bothers me…

He told me that
I don't love and

trust my #MON
enough.

I'm furious that I
lost to a bleeding heart like him.

…Humph! I don't
have the time for the likes of you!
ExecutiveM4BeforeText:
What? Who are you?
This is the office

of our leader,
GIOVANNI.

Since disbanding
TEAM ROCKET three

years ago, he has
been in training.

But we're certain
he will be back

some day to assume
command again.

That's why we're
standing guard.

I won't let any-
one disturb this place!
ExecutiveM4BeatenText:
I… I couldn't do a
thing…

GIOVANNI, please
forgive me…
ExecutiveM4AfterText:
No, I can't let
this affect me.

I have to inform
the others…
RocketBaseMurkrowText:
MURKROW: The
password is…

HAIL GIOVANNI.
GruntF5SeenText:
Do I know the
password?

Maybe.

But no weakling's
going to get it!
GruntF5BeatenText:
All right. Stop.
I'll tell you.
GruntF5AfterBattleText:
The password to
the boss's room is

SLOWPOKETAIL.

But it's useless
unless you have two passwords.
GruntM28SeenText:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!

You're challenging
me to a battle?

Hah! You're nuts,
but you have guts!

I like that!

If you can beat
me, I'll tell you

a password to the
boss's room!
GruntM28AfterBattleText:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!

The password to
the boss's room…

Uh…, I think it is
RATICATE TAIL.
ScientistRossSeenText:
I used to work for
SILPH, but now I

run research for
TEAM ROCKET.

A meddlesome child
like you needs to be punished.
ScientistRossBeatenText:
A mere tactical
error cost me…
ScientistRossAfterBattleText:
A radio signal
that drives #- MON mad…

My experiment is a
complete success.

My promotion is
assured. This loss

means absolutely
nothing.
ScientistMitchSeenText:
I don't care that
#MON are hurt by our experiment.
ScientistMitchBeatenText:
Thinking is my
strong suit, not battling.
ScientistMitchAfterBattleText:
If we turn up the
power of our radio

signal for broad-
cast nationwide…

The very thought
excites me!
TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorNeedsPassword:
The door's closed…

It needs two
passwords to open.
TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorOpenSesameTex:
The door's closed…

{PLAYER} entered
the two passwords.

The door opened!
